name: Ray-Octree Traversal (Gargantini and Atkinson variant)
aliases: Gargantini and Atkinson Octree Ray Traversal
definition: Adapts a ray traversal scheme to the octree structure and hashing scheme. Resembles Gargantini and Atkinson's technique, similar to kd-tree traversal with splits along X, Y, and Z mid-planes.
summary: This method traverses octrees by sorting mid-plane intersections and using rational arithmetic to maintain precision, avoiding floating-point errors.
